_meta.title: UAE pet import/export — verified reference
_meta.purpose: Shared, official-source-verified facts for all the X-to-Dubai (inbound) blogs. Use these as the authoritative UAE-side data.

import_into_uae.microchip: Permanent ISO microchip required; the chip number on the health certificate must match the implanted chip.
import_into_uae.rabies: Vaccination at age >=12 weeks; for a first or lapsed dose, >=21 days must pass before travel; no 21-day wait for a valid booster.
import_into_uae.titre_test: Required ONLY when importing from a high-risk (rabies) country: rabies antibody titration >=0.5 IU/ml, from an accredited lab, certificate valid 365 days (may be recorded in the health certificate). Rabies-free origins (e.g. UK, Australia): not required.
import_into_uae.minimum_age: 12 weeks from low-risk countries; >=15 weeks from high-risk countries.
import_into_uae.parasite_treatment: Internal + external parasite doses within 14 days before shipment, noted on the health certificate/passport.
import_into_uae.max_pets_note: 2 cats, or 2 dogs, or one of each, per person per year; resident pets returning are exempt.
documents_at_release: Vaccination record or passport (with chip no., description, vaccine details)
Certified veterinary health certificate from the origin's competent authority
import_into_uae.transport: Per IATA Live Animals Regulations; shipped directly, not mixed with other pets in transit.
import_into_uae.service_or_support_dogs: Service / emotional-support / medical dogs require extra docs (training certificate, owner medical report, ownership pledge).
import_into_uae.special_breeds_note: Bengal and Serval cats require a 5th-generation pedigree certificate.
import_into_uae.entry_points: Released via veterinary-quarantine centres at approved ports (Dubai Airport Cargo Village, Al Maktoum, Khalifa Port, Sharjah Airport, etc.); release permit issued electronically.

export_from_uae.note: The MOCCAE export permit is valid 30 days from electronic issuance (distinct from the 90-day import permit).

banned_dog_breeds_uae.legal_basis: UAE Federal Law No. 22 of 2016 (Possession of Dangerous Animals) + Ministerial Resolution 379/2022; UAE Government portal u.ae.
banned_dog_breeds_uae.penalty: Non-compliance fines AED 10,000-700,000, possible jail and confiscation.
banned_dog_breeds_uae.verification_status: List obtained from UAE Government sources (u.ae + the law). NOTE: the official law/resolution PDF was WAF-blocked to our automated tool -- capture a manual screenshot of the law/resolution annex to mark this 100%.
